title: Asynchronous Tasks With Django and Celery
description: Integrate Django and Celery with Redis as a message broker, and move slow work like sending email out of the request cycle.
summary: Celery is a distributed task queue that processes tasks asynchronously, so slow work doesn’t hold up your web app’s response. When you integrate Celery with your Django application, you can offload time-consuming tasks and keep your users from waiting.
takeaways: With Celery and Django, you can handle jobs like sending emails , processing images, and analyzing data without slowing down your application.
If you’re on Django 6.0 or later, then you’ll also see how Django’s built-in Tasks framework compares to Celery, so you can pick the right tool for your project.
To focus this tutorial on the essentials, you’ll integrate Celery into an existing Django app.
